description:
Unit: U6
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u6-normalize-the-numbered-example-lane

Outcome
The numbered public lesson order stays stable while example support, loaders, links, and proof ownership use final forms.

Requirements and decisions
R2, R4, R8, R10-R13, R16; KTD1-KTD3, KTD6, KTD8, KTD9.

Affected surfaces
test/examples/**; examples/**; shared example support; test/examples/catalog.yml; test/quality/component_proof.yml; and current README links.

Implementation direction
Keep numbered lesson and catalog structure. Rename executable modules and shared fixtures. Update loaders and common runtime support. Preserve :example and :peer on peer cases. Keep repetition when standalone teaching needs it. Register examples as supplemental executable-documentation proof, never the canonical behavior owner.

Acceptance
The catalog resolves every lesson and current link. Examples stay out of default and run through test.examples. Peer cases retain both roles. Standalone lessons use current support. Every example evidence group names its documentation claim and canonical component.

Verification
mix test.examples --warnings-as-errors
mix test.peer --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/examples/catalog_test.exs test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
The catalog and peer cases pass, example proof claims are registered, and U7 can start.
title: U6 Normalize the numbered example lane
